sections.label: ⚙️ Internal
items: Added `tests/live/uniqdrop-structure-section.spec.js`, the first live Playwright spec built on WIP.1's `window.__saTest` hook — exercises the unique-values dropdown's "Structure" section (empty/single-row/collapsed/expanded cell states) against a real MusicBrainz page. Test tooling only; no userscript runtime changes.

sections.label: ⚙️ Internal
items: Added a `window.__saTest` debug hook (`getUniqDropSections()`, `closeUniqDrop()`), gated behind `window.__SA_TEST_MODE__` — a read-only introspection surface for the Playwright test harness, inert outside test runs. Adds no UI and changes no user-visible behavior.
